finding: FieldView Drive collects, stores and transfers field data in real time.
Harvest data can be analyzed by field, soil and seed type.
Scouting maps, vegetation maps and true-color imagery are supported.
Supports variable-rate seed and fertility prescriptions.
External API connectivity is offered in the paid plan.
Soil moisture, soil temperature, weather, EC saturated paste and ETa inputs support agronomic recommendations.
Sensor data guides irrigation timing and amount.
Advisory insights cover fungal disease crop protection.
Field-level daily real-time ETa is measured and combined with soil water availability.
Zones can be generated from satellite, topography, soil, sensors, yield and as-applied datasets.
VRA maps are machinery-compatible and fertilizer prescription maps can be exported.
Yield-data analytics are a named product capability.
As-applied and as-planted data are supported as a product capability.
Field changes can be tracked offline and synchronized in the operations workflow.
Offline georeferenced scouting supports photos, notes and voice recordings.
Supports GPS tracking, irregularity alerts and fuel monitoring across machinery brands.
Satellite, soil, yield and scouting data can be overlaid to build prescription maps.
Provides crop-health monitoring, vegetation changes and soil-moisture monitoring.
Supports precipitation, temperature, cold stress and heat stress analysis.
Mobile and web products share fields and data for monitoring, scouting and observations.
Supports productivity analysis, VRA maps, soil sampling and field trials.
Integrates with John Deere Operations Center, exports prescription formats and imports yield data.
Offers NDVI-based crop, soil and moisture monitoring with alerts.
